北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京体感 -11℃，天阴寒冷，外出务必多穿衣哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing feels -11℃ and cloudy. Please bundle up when going out!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪大雾弥漫，体感 2℃ 湿冷，出行注意交通安全！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy and feels 2℃ damp and cold. Please travel safely!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海天阴微凉，气温 5℃ 左右，记得带伞以防小雨。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and cool, around 5℃. Remember your umbrella for possible light rain.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云暖和，体感 25℃ 舒适，注意防晒补水哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and warm, feels 25℃. Remember sunscreen and hydration!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光灿烂，体感 25℃ 宜人，户外活动别忘了防晒！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and feels 25℃ pleasant. Don't forget sunscreen for outdoor activities!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州大雾，体感 2℃ 湿冷，出行小心慢行，注意保暖。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy and feels 2℃ damp and cold. Drive carefully and stay warm.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天微冷，体感 1℃，出门添衣，谨防感冒。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and a bit cold, feels 1℃. Add clothes and avoid catching a cold.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阳光正好，体感 14℃ 舒适，正是出门好时光。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu has perfect sunshine, feels 14℃. It's a great time to go out.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阵雨微凉，体感 2℃ 湿冷，记得带伞，注意添衣。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has light showers, feels 2℃ damp and cold. Bring an umbrella and add clothes.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安天气晴朗，体感 5℃ 左右，早晚温差大，注意保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and feels around 5℃. Mind the large temperature difference and stay warm.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有霾，体感 14℃ 宜人，请注意防护，减少户外剧烈运动。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has haze, feels 14℃ pleasant. Please take precautions and reduce strenuous outdoor activities.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒，体感 -28℃，务必全副武装，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, feels -28℃. Bundle up completely and prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -28℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳寒冷，体感 -21℃，出门穿厚点，保暖最重要。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cold, feels -21℃. Dress warmly when going out, staying warm is key.
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -21℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光明媚，体感 12℃ 舒适，享受好天气吧！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and feels 12℃ pleasant. Enjoy the good weather!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云暖和，体感 18℃ 适宜，湿度较大，注意除湿。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and warm, feels 18℃ suitable. High humidity, consider dehumidifying.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云寒冷，体感 -8℃，出门多穿，小心着凉。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and cold, feels -8℃. Wear more layers and avoid catching a cold.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云严寒，体感 -17℃，记得戴帽手套，全副武装。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and severely cold, feels -17℃. Remember hats and gloves, bundle up completely.
大连.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -17℃
